description: Perform an authenticated news search using the Tavily API with advanced payload parameters (timeframe and result limits). The credential is read dynamically from the environment.
nl_goal: I am tracking recent tech policies. Please write a Python script using the Tavily Search API to find the top 3 news articles from the past 7 days regarding 'Artificial Intelligence Regulations'. You MUST read your API key from the `TAVILY_API_KEY` environment variable. Print the titles and URLs of the articles.

paradigm_3_config.skill_description: An authenticated tool to retrieve real-time news articles using the Tavily API with advanced filters like timeframe and maximum results. Requires TAVILY_API_KEY environment variable.
